tfn.s: The writer suggests that an unsuccessful landing could still have been harmful.

tfn.s: The writer thinks groups that avoid outsiders probably do so because they know nothing about the wider world.

speak.title: Role-play: should we share this video?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the friend who found the video
a.text: You found a video online of a visit to a remote community that does not want visitors. You think it is interesting and want to share it. Explain why, and listen to your friend's worries.

b.role: the friend who is not sure
b.text: You think the video may not be respectful. Ask where it came from and who agreed to it. Say what you would prefer to share instead. Try to agree on a decision.

phrases: I'm not sure we should share this.
I can see why it's interesting, but they didn't ask to be filmed.
What if the community doesn't want to be seen?
I'd rather check the source first.
We could share an article about their rights instead.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you share the video, and what was your main reason?
